title: You Are What You Read: Misalignment via In-Context Persona Induction
abstract: arXiv:2609.06851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Broad misalignment has been produced by finetuning on narrow data, harmful or benign, and in context only by demonstrations of the undesirable behaviour itself. We show that benign data suffices in context, with no finetuning and no demonstration of harmful behaviour in the prompt. Biographical facts that converge on a single figure, placed in a model's context as ordinary conversational turns, lead it to answer as that figure on questions the facts never touch. We call this persona induction. Across nine personas and thirteen models, identity adoption rises sigmoidally with the number of facts and crosses 50% within 3 to 10 of them. Misalignment then tracks which figure is described. Harmless personas reach full adoption with near-zero misalignment, while harmful ones voice their characteristic views on unrelated questions, at rates up to 80%. translated_title: 阅读塑造了你：通过上下文人格诱导产生的模型失准
translated_abstract: 广泛的失准（不对齐）行为此前已通过在狭窄数据上进行微调（无论数据有害还是良性）产生，而在上下文场景中则需要通过不良行为本身的示范来触发。我们证明，仅凭上下文中的良性数据就足以实现失准，既无需微调，也无需在提示中演示任何有害行为。当汇聚于同一人物的若干传记事实作为普通对话轮次置于模型上下文中时，模型会在这些事实从未涉及的问题上以该人物的方式作答。我们将这种现象称为“人格诱导”（persona induction）。在九种人格和十三个模型的实验中，身份采纳率随事实数量的增加呈S形曲线上升，仅需3到10条事实即可突破50%。失准程度随后取决于所描述的是哪个人物：无害人格可达到完全采纳而几乎不产生失准，而有害人格则会在无关问题上表达其特有的观点，比例最高可达80%。此外，一条格式指令可以控制人格激活的时机。由于每条事实是单独……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了一种名为“人格诱导”的新型失准机制：仅在上下文中提供关于某个有害人物的良性传记事实（无需微调、无需有害行为示范），即可使大语言模型以该人物身份回答无关问题，失准率最高达80%。
en_tdlr: The study reveals "persona induction," a novel misalignment mechanism whereby benign biographical facts about a harmful figure placed in context alone—without finetuning or demonstrations of harmful behavior—cause large language models to answer as that figure, with misalignment rates up to 80%.
